paragraphs: R' Shimon son of R' Yannai. His sister told him in their father's name: Jerusalem Shabbat, end of Ha-Oreg, end of Kol Kitvei, and Ba-Meh Tomin. R' Shimon bar Yannai harvested his vineyard during the intermediate festival days. He saw everyone harvesting after him. The next year he left it, and it dried up. “They learn from what is wrong, but do not learn from what is right”: Jerusalem Mo'ed Katan 2:2.
